name: Commerce CardPointe
description: A Drupal Commerce on-site payment gateway for CardPointe (CardConnect / Fiserv) using the hosted iframe tokenizer, with optional Clover Flex integrated-terminal (card-present) support.
project_description:
This module integrates the CardPointe Gateway API from Clover Connect, utilizing their Hosted iFrame Tokenizer to securely collect customer card data directly on Clover web servers.

 
 Features 
 
 Provides a Hosted Iframe Payment Gateway 
 Provides a Terminal Payment Gateway that integrates with Clover Flex, allowing you to process card present transactions
 
 Supports voids, captures, and refunds through the order management interface
 
 
 
 
 Drupal 10.3 & 11 / Commerce CardPointe 2.0.0 
 Installation 
 Commerce CardPointe 2.0.0 should only be installed via Composer. The zip files on this page are provided for informative purposes only.

 Drupal 10.3.0 or newer is required.

 
 
 Drupal 8 & 9 & 10 & 11 / Commerce CardPointe 1.1.3 
 Installation 
 Commerce CardPointe 1.1.3 should only be installed via Composer. The zip files on this page are provided for informative purposes only.

 Drupal 8 or newer is required.
